description: A synthesised drum built from six tonal oscillators and a noise oscillator stacked into a modal spectrum, folded and re-enveloped, after Noise Engineering's Basimilus Iteritas Alter

params.text: Sets the fundamental, three octaves below to five above C1 at 32.7Hz, before the range switch is added
Sets how much spectrum there is: one oscillator fully anticlockwise, a second fading in over the first quarter, and then the decays and the levels of the other four staggered in over the rest
Sets the intervals between the partials, from the harmonic series fully anticlockwise to the prime series fully clockwise, blended in the log domain; the fundamental itself never moves
Sets the wave every oscillator uses, sine, triangle, sawtooth and square in three equal thirds of the turn
Lowers the folder's reflection threshold over its first three quarters, and over the last quarter crossfades in a train of decaying pulses fired at every peak and trough of the tonal sum
One knob doing two things: from fully anticlockwise to noon it mixes in a burst of noise, loudest at the far end, and from noon to fully clockwise the attack stretches out to 2 seconds
Sets how long the hit takes to die, 5ms to 4 seconds, for all the oscillators together; the harm knob sets how much of that each partial gets
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the knob above
Chooses how the oscillators relate: skin is plain additive, liquid adds a pitch envelope to every oscillator, and metal has them modulate each other as two three-operator stacks
Offsets the whole voice by octaves: bass adds none, alto two and treble four
Strikes the voice by hand, and lights the lamp beside the trigger jack

inputs.text: Moves the pitch one volt per octave through the attenuverter beside it, which is the only one of the seven that starts fully open
Added to the harm knob through the attenuverter beside it
Added to the spread knob through the attenuverter beside it
Added to the morph knob through the attenuverter beside it
Added to the fold knob through the attenuverter beside it
Added to the attack knob through the attenuverter beside it
Added to the decay knob through the attenuverter beside it
While it is patched it overrides the mode switch, splitting nought to five volts three ways: skin below 1.67V, liquid below 3.33V and metal above
While it is patched it overrides the range switch, splitting nought to five volts three ways in the same fashion
A rising edge through 1.5V strikes the voice; there is no legato, so a retrigger restarts every envelope from zero

outputs.text: The voice's own envelope, 0V to 10V: the whole of what drives the folder, attack and decay together, so it follows harm, attack and decay as well as the trigger

notes: the partials do not share one envelope: harm staggers both their levels and their decay lengths, so the spectrum collapses towards the fundamental as the hit dies.
the spread knob is a timbre control and not a tuning one. The prime end has an ambiguous pitch the way a bell does, but nothing is transposed.
menu: Sample rate — Fundamental-locked (hardware), which runs the engine at a power-of-two multiple of the fundamental so every alias lands on a harmonic of the note, or Clean (oversampled)
16-bit quantization — rounds the engine's output to sixteen bits, which the fundamental-locked mode does and the clean mode ignores
Spread law — Harmonic -> prime, which is what the spread knob does by default, or Extended (unison -> harmonic -> prime), which adds a detuned-unison stretch below the harmonic series
Free-run at full decay — makes the top of the decay knob hold the envelopes open instead of decaying, so the module becomes an oscillator
Liquid pitch depth — how far the liquid mode's pitch envelope sweeps: 1 octave, 2 octaves, 3 octaves or 4 octaves
Output level — 5 Vpp, 10 Vpp or 14 Vpp
